answers.description: A stylized, top-down view of a heavily modified, rusted electric sprint car against a solid magenta background. The vehicle features a narrow, elongated chassis with a rear-mounted engine, visible yellow coil springs, and a complex network of black cables and hoses. The front end is equipped with a single, large, barbed steel harpoon on a central rail, emitting pale blue-white electric arcs. The car has four wheels, with the rear wheels partially obscured by the bodywork, and the overall aesthetic is gritty and mechanical, with a focus on worn, industrial materials.
